steps.say: A plural means more than one. Most words just add -s.
Words ending in s, sh, ch, x or z add -es. Say them aloud and you can hear the extra sound.
steps.show: bus → buses, dish → dishes, box → boxes

steps.say: If a word ends in a consonant and y, change the y to i. Then add -es.
If a word ends in a vowel and y, just add -s.
steps.show: day → days, key → keys, toy → toys

steps.say: Check the letter before the y. It tells you which rule to use.

options.why: Dish ends in sh, so it needs -es.
Dish does not end in y.
Dish is for one. There are two.

hints: Look at the last two letters of dish.
Say the plural aloud. Can you hear an extra sound at the end?
check.explanation: Dish ends in sh, so we add -es: dishes.
